algorithm.surface: actual ground mesh triangles via Blender BVH; no heightJson fallback
algorithm.gapDefinition: AABB bottom-center bboxMinY minus actual terrain triangle Y below the footprint center; if center misses, median actual bottom-vertex hits are used and identified; corners and grid misses are explicit; negative means embedded
algorithm.footprintGrid: 7x7 diagnostic samples; misses remain null and never become zero

mapping.matrix: GLB imported Blender Z-up -> runtime Y-up
